finding: Per-response sanitization does not prove exhaustive pagination. Every retained page must be linked to the prior response's Link rel=next target, and the retained final page must not advertise another page.

primary_sources.claim: Paginated responses use the Link header; clients must follow rel=next until it is absent.
Requests should transmit an explicit X-GitHub-Api-Version value.

uncertainty: No authenticated private-repository enumeration was executed.
The validator is not yet wired into the retained-evidence CLI.
Live response URL normalization behavior has not yet been exercised.
falsification_route: A retained page request URL differs from the exact prior rel=next URL and validation still succeeds.
A final retained page contains rel=next and validation still succeeds.
Duplicate run IDs or cross-commit records are accepted.
An unsanitized or rejected response envelope is accepted.
next_action: Wire the chain validator immediately after per-page sanitization in both authenticated enumeration clients, then feed only a verified link_chain_complete envelope into reconciliation and retained evidence bundling.
